bio.text: Selina Bliss is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 1; she assumed office on January 9, 2023.

She was born in Wagner, South Dakota, graduated from Prescott High School, and earned a bachelor's (1984) and master's degree (1992) in nursing from Arizona State University and a doctorate in nursing education from Capella University (2014).
Her career experience includes working as a nurse and nurse educator.
She advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
